scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @pulseml/shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @pulseml/api" "npm run dev --workspace @pulseml/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pulseml/shared && npm run build --workspace @pulseml/api && npm run build --workspace @pulseml/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @pulseml/shared && npm run lint --workspace @pulseml/api && npm run lint --workspace @pulseml/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @pulseml/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @pulseml/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @pulseml/web
